newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says needs improved profitability.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says needs improved profitability.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Friday it needed to increase profitability to finance its fast growth.
"We are now growing faster than we can handle on our own so we must increase profits," chief executive Lars Ramqvist told Reuters after the annual general meeting.
"We must work hard and streamline our production. It is not an option to turn to shareholders for capital."
Ramqvist said sales could grow between 20 and 22 percent annually, in a mix of crowns and dollars, without external financing but that it was currently growing at a slightly faster rate.
Ericsson earlier released first quarter earnings showing pre-tax profit rose 30 percent to 2.02 billion crowns, while order intake and sales rose 36 percent in crowns and about 20 percent in dollars.
Ramqvist said it was possible to keep cutting costs faster than the price pressure increase, which he estimated to an average of about 20 percent annually.
